tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU real32 build, dt = 60 s, mp=6 ra_lw=1 ra_sw=1 sf_sfclay_physics=1 sf_surface=1 bl_pbl=1, `data/eqwefic/scm_ref`) dumped around the sf_sfclayrev_run call by the instrumented ctessum-claude/WRF fork (e42a269, module_esm_dump) and replayed through the real64 (kind_phys = real64) standalone kernels/sfclayrev_driver of that fork against the ctessum-claude/MMM-physics kernel 52cfbd7 (NCAR/MMM-physics 550b5b4 plus kind-generic fixes). Inputs are the dumped kernel arguments (real32 values widened to real64 exactly as the driver read them); every expected value is the real64 replay's output. The scheme is diagnostic (no time step), so the values are pointwise. Tolerances: measured against the real64 replay with zero tolerances, the mismatch of this component is <= 4e-6 relative and is concentrated in the quantities that pass through the small virtual-temperature difference theta_v1 - theta_vs (Ri_b, zol, rmol, psi_m, psi_h, theta*, hfx: 2.7e-6 to 3.9e-6) and in what they feed (exchange and drag coefficients, fluxes, 10 m/2 m diagnostics: 1e-6 to 2e-6); the direct thermodynamic quantities (cpm, qgh, gz1oz0, wspd, znt) agree to better than 1e-6. Cause: the kernel receives real32 copies of the WRF constants (svpt0 = 273.1499939 K, whose 6e-6 K offset moves the skin saturation mixing ratio by 4e-7 relative and hence theta_vs by 6e-7 K, which is 2e-6 of the 0.3 K virtual-temperature difference; g = 9.8100004, karman = 0.40000001, ep1 = 0.60836244, svp1 = 0.61119998) and evaluates its default-real literals (1/2.5, sqrt(3), atan(1), the table nodes n*0.01) in single precision, while this component uses the nominal values from lib/wrf_constants.esm; the real32 in-model dump differs from the real64 replay by up to 1.7e-5 (zol). Tolerances are therefore rel 2e-5 (5x the measured floor) on every quantity downstream of theta_v1 - theta_vs and rel 1e-6 on the rest; regime is exact. Regime: SCM call 1 (the first physics step, 19:00 UTC = 12:34 LST): land, Ri_b = -0.058 (regime 4, free convection) with the previous-step friction velocity at its 1e-4 m/s initial value, so the kernel takes the first-guess branch zol = Ri_b ln((za+z0)/z0) instead of the secant solver; the previous heat fluxes are zero (no convective velocity) and the previous surface humidity is zero, so qsfc is the skin saturation value.
